IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: P1 - Multiple health check failures for CDN POPs in eu-central-3 / eu-west-1. Detected packet loss > 30% on edge egress paths. Paging oncall rotation now.@here
Amanda Chen: Acked. I'm the active SRE. Looking at dashboards, see spike in tcp retransmits to our edge nodes.
Amanda Chen: Quick checks - are customer-facing routes dropping or is this last-mile ISP issue?
Liao Wu: I ran mtr to one affected POP:```
mtr -r -c 50 edge-eu-central-3.cdn.redwood.local
Start: 2026-03-06 14:12:32
HOST: laptop                 Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
  1. 10.0.0.1                 0.0%    50    1.2   1.5   0.9   6.7   0.9
  2. 198.51.100.5             2.0%    50   12.3  11.9  10.1  45.8   6.3
  3. 203.0.113.8             36.0%    50   45.1  42.8  20.2 120.6  19.0
  4. edge-eu-central-3       38.0%    50   40.9  42.5  18.9 110.2  18.6
```
Liao Wu: Looks like packet loss upstream of the POP (hop 3).
Tony Ops: I'm opening a ticket with our CDN partner NOC and cloud provider network. Ticket 894312 opened with initial traceroutes.
PagerDuty: Pager triggered: Incident acknowledged by Amanda Chen. Escalation to SRE lead and network NOC in progress.
Amanda Chen: Mitigation plan: 1) Fail traffic for eu-central-3 to secondary edge pool in eu-west-2 via CDN control plane; 2) Increase cache TTLs and enable cache-only mode for static assets; 3) Notify customers via status page with limited scope.
Sanjay Patel: FYI - traffic shift will add ~20ms latency for affected customers but should remove packet loss. I'll coordinate the CDN config change.
cdn-provider-bot: Executed route tweeter: shift edge pool rule applied to service:cdn-app, from eu-central-3 -> eu-west-2 (partial). Rule id: r-77bcd. TTLs updated for static paths.
Amanda Chen: Running quick sanity curl against a known failing URL before/after:```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total} %{http_code}\n" https://static.prod.redwood.com/assets/logo.png
before: 2.41 200
after: 0.18 200
```
Amanda Chen: Good, partial mitigation working for static assets. Dynamic endpoints still showing errors (502/504).
Liao Wu: Captured tcpdump at edge, seeing retransmits and RSTs to backend IPs. Suspect packet reordering or physical congestion on provider backbone.
Tony Ops: Cloud provider update: "we're seeing elevated packet loss on fiber segment X between POPs in region, RFO under investigation." They propose BGP flap damping and reroute; ETA 1-2h.
Sanjay Patel: While provider works, we should enable origin fallback to long-lived keep-alive routing and queue up degraded-mode responses for chat endpoints. I'll push a canary config.
Amanda Chen: Draft status update for status.redwood.com: "We are investigating increased packet loss affecting edge POPs in EU regions. Partial traffic rerouting underway; some customers may see increased latency or transient errors for dynamic requests. Our teams are working with the CDN and cloud provider NOCs." Approve? :eyes:
Liao Wu: Approve. Add note about affected subset: primarily eu-central-3 and eu-west-1 POPs, ~12% of total edge requests.
Amanda Chen: Posting update now.
Amanda Chen: Cross-team ask: SREs, please avoid deploys to CDN-configured services for next 2 hours. Devs: hold non-critical pushes.
Sanjay Patel: CDN can do a partial soft-redeploy to tweak keepalive; I'll perform that in 5m. Monitoring will watch 5xx rate and latency.
cdn-provider-bot: Soft-redeploy completed for service:cdn-app on eu-central-3 -> confirmed partial routing to fallback pool.
Amanda Chen: Observability - set alert threshold to double-check fallback success.
Tony Ops: Created customer impact list for CSMs: customers with heavy EU traffic flagged for PM outreach.
Amanda Chen: On-call handoff in 30m: Sanjay will take primary and I'll provide runbook + context.
Sanjay Patel: Taking handoff at 15:40 UTC. My plan: maintain current reroute, keep CDN partner engaged, and coordinate with cloud provider until packet loss resolves or we have stable BGP alternative.
Amanda Chen: Handoff notes: root cause likely infra fiber segment / backbone congestion; mitigation = CDN-level reroute + cache TTLs + degraded-mode for dynamic endpoints. No config rollbacks expected. Current severity P1 but customer-impact scope shrinking.
Liao Wu: We've been collecting packet captures and mtr runs, will attach to ticket 894312.
Tony Ops: If provider ETA slips, next step is scaled customer communications and possible credits escalation path.
Sanjay Patel: Acknowledged. Will update status every 30m.
Amanda Chen: Thanks team. Leaving on-call to Sanjay at 15:40 UTC. If anything changes before then ping me directly. :wave:
Sanjay Patel: Acknowledge takeover.
IncidentBot: Incident severity unchanged (P1). Next scheduled update will be at 15:40 UTC. Logs: https://incidents.redwood.com/894312
Amanda Chen: (after 40m) Observability shows 5xx down 70% from peak, packet loss on backbone trending down from 38% -> 6%. Good progress.
Sanjay Patel: Provider reports partial fiber reroute in place; they're continuing repairs. We'll keep CDN reroute until clean line confirmed for 2h.
Tony Ops: Closing notes prep - will prepare RCA skeleton. Handoff complete.
Sanjay Patel: I'll keep monitoring and post final update once provider confirms full restoration.
IncidentBot: Incident acknowledged by SRE oncall handoff.
